name: Coefficient Space of the Interacting-Cycle Class
scope: Homotopy equivalence; the full homeomorphism is $B_G\times\mathbb R^{50}$.
proof: Modulo the full diagonal, the two cycle diagonals become distinct lines in $\mathbb R^4$. Their complement retracts radially to $S^3$ minus four points, equivalently $\mathbb R^3$ minus three points, which has the stated wedge homotopy type.
